# <span class="en">Analytical assumptions and methodological decisions</span><span class="zh">分析假设与方法决策</span> {#sec-assump}

::: {.en}
Every result in the following sections depends on a handful of choices that
the data do not make for the analyst. They are collected here, with the
reason for each and the place where its consequence is tested.
:::

::: {.zh}
后文的每一个结果都取决于若干数据本身不会替分析者做出的选择。这里把它们集中列出,
并说明每个选择的理由,以及检验其后果的位置。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-decisions
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Analytical decisions, their rationale, and where each is tested.</span><span class='zh'>分析决策、理由及检验位置。</span>"

tribble(
  ~Decision, ~Choice, ~Rationale, ~`Tested in`,
  "Quantity analysed", "Raw event counts and fatality sums",
    "The brief asks for counts. No defensible population denominator exists: the last census is from 2014, and more than three million people have since been displaced, overwhelmingly from the townships where the conflict is.",
    "§6.5: log(1 + count) and events per 1,000 km²",
  "Neighbour definition", "Queen contiguity, plus the two island links",
    "Contiguity follows how fighting moves between townships on the ground. Distance bands would give small urban townships dozens of neighbours and large Shan townships none.",
    "§6.5 and §7.6: k = 6 nearest neighbours",
  "Weights", "Row-standardised",
    "The spatial lag becomes the neighbourhood average, which is what the LISA quadrants are read against, and townships with many neighbours do not dominate.",
    "—",
  "Inference", "Conditional permutation, 999 draws",
    "Counts this skewed make the normal approximation a poor reference for local statistics.",
    "—",
  "Significance (LMSA)", "Two-sided simulated p < 0.05; FDR shown alongside",
    "The brief asks for p < 0.05. With 329 tests, about 16 false positives are expected at that level, so FDR-surviving townships are outlined on every map.",
    "§6.2–6.5",
  "Time unit", "Quarter (19 periods)",
    "Long enough to smooth reporting noise and halve the empty cells; short enough to resolve the 2023 escalation.",
    "§7.6: monthly cube",
  "EHSA time lag", "k = 1 quarter",
    "sfdep's default; a township's neighbourhood includes the previous quarter.",
    "§7.6: k = 0 and k = 2",
  "EHSA null model", "Period-conditional permutation",
    "Compares each township only with other townships in the same quarter, consistent with how Gi* is standardised. sfdep's pooled null is shown to confound the national trend with local significance.",
    "§7.3",
  "EHSA significance", "Folded p ≤ 0.05, as in sfdep",
    "Keeps the classification rule identical to sfdep's, so that the null model is the only change. This is a two-sided test at 0.10.",
    "§7.6: two-sided p ≤ 0.05"
) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_width(Decision ~ px(130), Choice ~ px(170), Rationale ~ px(420)) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12.5))
```

## <span class="en">Why counts and not rates</span><span class="zh">为什么用计数而不是比率</span>

::: {.en}
A rate per person would be the natural measure of exposure, and it is not
available. Myanmar's last complete census was taken in 2014, and the census
the military government attempted in 2024 could not be carried out across
large parts of the country. Even an accurate 2014 figure would be the wrong denominator: the
displacement since 2021 has emptied precisely the townships with the most
conflict, so a 2014-based rate would overstate risk per remaining resident by
an unknown and spatially varying factor. The counts are therefore read as
what they are, a measure of where violent events happen, not of individual
risk. Area-based density is used as a sensitivity check, because township
area does vary by two orders of magnitude.
:::

::: {.zh}
人均比率本应是衡量暴露程度的自然指标,但无法获得。缅甸最近一次完整的普查在
2014 年;军政府 2024 年尝试进行的普查在全国大片地区无法开展。即使有准确的 2014 年数据,它也是
错误的分母:2021 年以来的流离失所恰恰掏空了冲突最多的镇区,因此以 2014 年为基础的
比率会以一个未知且空间上变化的倍数,高估每名留守居民的风险。因此,计数就按其本来
的含义来解读:**暴力事件发生在哪里**,而不是个人风险。由于镇区面积相差两个数量级,
本研究以按面积计算的密度作为敏感性检验。
:::

## <span class="en">Reporting is not occurrence</span><span class="zh">被报道不等于发生</span>

::: {.en}
ACLED codes events from media, local partner organisations and other
reports, and its coverage is better where reporting is denser
[@raleigh2023]. Event datasets of this kind are known to under-record violence
in remote areas and to vary with media attention [@eck2012; @weidmann2016].
In Myanmar, internet shutdowns and restrictions on journalists add to the
gap. A cold spot can therefore mean an area with little violence or an area
with little reporting. The analysis cannot separate the two, and the
interpretation in @sec-ehsa and @sec-integration keeps the possibility in
view, especially for the Wa and eastern Shan hills, where the cold zone is
largest.
:::

::: {.zh}
ACLED 依据媒体、地方合作机构与其他报告对事件进行编码,报道越密集的地方覆盖越好
[@raleigh2023]。已知这类事件数据集会低估偏远地区的暴力,并随媒体关注度而变化
[@eck2012; @weidmann2016]。在缅甸,断网与对记者的限制进一步扩大了这一差距。因此,
**冷点可能意味着暴力少,也可能意味着报道少**。分析无法区分二者,@sec-ehsa 与
@sec-integration 的解读始终把这种可能性放在视野之内,尤其是冷区面积最大的佤邦与
掸邦东部山地。
:::

## <span class="en">Multiple testing</span><span class="zh">多重检验</span>

::: {.en}
A local statistic is one hypothesis test per township, so a map of 329
townships at p < 0.05 contains about `r expected_fp(N_TS)` significant
results even if the data have no spatial structure at all. The brief asks for
maps of p < 0.05, and those are drawn. The tests are also neighbours of one
another and share data, so the false discovery rate procedure of
@benjamini1995, as applied to local statistics by @caldas2006, is reported
alongside, and townships that survive it are outlined on the maps. A
township with a coloured fill and a heavy outline is significant under both;
a fill without an outline is significant only at the unadjusted level.
:::

::: {.zh}
局部统计量对每个镇区做一次假设检验,所以即便数据完全没有空间结构,329 个镇区在
p < 0.05 下也会出现约 `r expected_fp(N_TS)` 个显著结果。作业要求绘制 p < 0.05 的
地图,本报告照此绘制。由于这些检验彼此相邻、共享数据,本报告同时报告
@benjamini1995 提出、并由 @caldas2006 应用于局部统计量的错误发现率(FDR)校正,
通过校正的镇区在地图上加粗描边。**有填色且粗描边**的镇区在两种标准下都显著;
**只有填色没有描边**的镇区只在未校正水平下显著。
:::
